Must have skills required: react, Python, microservice architecture, GCP, Azure (Microsoft Azure), AWS, C++, C#, Elastic Search, Open search, Kubernates NovaCore Systems is Looking for: Job Summary HME is seeking a Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience to build and deliver high-quality software solutions across a variety of products and platforms. The ideal candidate is a strongprogrammer and problem solver who can learn quickly, take ownership, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. This role requires a hands-on engineer who enjoys tackling challenging technical problems, working across different technologies, and contributing wherever needed to help the team succeed. What you will do in the position: Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications and services. Build backend services, APIs, and microservices that are secure, reliable, and maintainable. Collaborate with product managers, architects, QA engineers, and other team members to deliver customer-focused solutions. Write clean, efficient, and well-tested code following engineering best practices. Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the software stack. Participate in software design discussions and contribute to architectural decisions. Work across multiple projects and technologies in a fast-paced environment. Continuously improve application performance, reliability, and maintainability. Learn new technologies and frameworks as needed to support business goals. Contribute to team success by taking ownership and delivering results with a strong sense of urgency. What you will need to succeed in this position: 2+ years of professional software development experience. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Strong programming and problem-solving skills with solid computer science fundamentals. Experience developing backend applications using Python (preferred), Java, C#, or C++. Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases, with strong SQL query development skills. Ability to quickly learn new technologies and work across different technical domains. Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Preferred Qualifications: Experience building web applications using ReactJS or similar frontend frameworks. Experience working with edge devices, embedded systems, or device-connected applications. Experience with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch. Familiarity with containers and Kubernetes. Experience with one or more cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and logging tools. Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and working with microservices-based architectures. Experience with distributed systems and cloud-native application development. Demonstrated passion for technology, continuous learning, and taking on new challenges. Interview Process: Online test, 1 hr Technical round 1 - face to face at Bangalore office (DSA / system design mix) Technical Round 2 - Mrinal, managerial + technical.
